entities.summary: Maya Joint is an Australian professional tennis player. She has a career-high WTA singles ranking of world No. 29 and a best doubles ranking of No. 47, both achieved on 2 February 2026. Joint has won four WTA Tour titles combined, two in singles and two in doubles.
